name: app-in-a-box
description: Turn an app idea into a provisioned, instrumented, CI-gated Expo + FastAPI + Supabase repo with a full agent harness.

interface.shortDescription: Rambled idea → tuned prototype → production MVP in an afternoon
interface.longDescription: A product advisor shapes your idea with you from a ramble, checks the market in the background, and a design team builds a clickable prototype of every screen that you tune (look, layouts, density, motion, features) before anything is built; then it walks you through free-tier accounts, scaffolds Expo + FastAPI + Supabase with auth, analytics and error monitoring, provisions the cloud resources, and installs CI, PR review, skills, subagents, hooks and memory that work in both Codex and Claude Code.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $new-app to build my app idea in this folder.
